items.html: And behold, this corona is not a complete Sefira, for after the Gadlut of ZA is entirely complete, its place will be in the upper third of the Tifferet of ZA alone, which is a third of a measure; therefore it does not need a full year for its entry, and it enters immediately, and this is called one day. And behold, already now a light began to be revealed in the Daat of ZA, and since the Daat of ZA already has the light of this corona revealed in it, and he has a Daat slightly more than he had at first, therefore he is now called "poet" (young child), in the secret of "the acquisition of the small children is a valid acquisition," for they are called small children from the age of six years and one day, which is the beginning of the seventh year and onward. And the reason the sages said that his acquisition is a valid acquisition in movables alone, the reason is that only the aspect of VAK of the Tzelem has entered, and the VAK are called movables because they are moved and turned from mercy to judgment and from judgment to mercy, unlike the three first Mochin themselves of the Tzelem.
